title: P2 cluster report
description: One file per cluster: docs/internal/test-refactor/reports/<cluster>.json. Checked by scripts/check_report.py.

verification.description: Which findings the verify agents checked, and the counts per verdict.

behaviors.description: Check C1: public behaviors of the main code and the tests that check them.

pass.description: Main-code unit, e.g. a class or an optimizer pass.

tests.description: Empty when no test checks the behavior.

id.description: Unique across all reports: the cluster prefix and a number, e.g. T-16 or C07-3.

scope.description: Exactly one scope from the spec's scope list. main-bug findings also get an F-entry in findings.md.

module.description: Top-level module directory of the test files to change, e.g. scalus-core.

ciSavingSec.description: Seconds of CI time saved; negative when the change adds CI time.

linesRemoved.description: Estimate of test lines deleted minus lines added; negative when the action adds tests.

verification.description: Verify agent's correction; overrides claim and action when the verdict is NARROWED.

findingsLog.description: Required for main-bug: the findings.md entry.

fileRef.description: Repository-relative path, a colon, and a line or line range, e.g. scalus-core/shared/src/test/scala/X.scala:12-80.
